aweme_info.content_desc: ["here’s the guide \ud83d\udcaa it's called body recomposition (losing fat while building muscle at the same time). for everyone asking how, here's what helped me!! 1. diet: prioritize protein in every meal and eat good quality carbs like sweet potatoes, rice, and oats. if fat loss is your goal, a small calorie deficit will help. 2. workouts: lift weights 3-5 times a week. don't just copy random influencer workouts or train without a plan. follow a structured routine and focus on progressive overload. 3. coaching or apps: SO helpful!! i followed the weight loss program in Vanholt Fitness app. it builds a personalized workout plan based on your starting physique, goals and equipment. it also has exercise tutorials, progressive overload tracking and calorie \u0026 macro tracking! 4. patience: you can't choose where you lose fat (arms, legs, stomach, etc.), but you CAN build specific muscles through targeted exercises. that's why having a structured plan matters!! 5. sleep: aim for 8+ hours a night. recovery is just as important as training!!","save this for later and remember, consistency is everything \ud83e\udef6\ud83d\udc97"]

original_client_text.markup_text:
After 30 your body loses 3-5% of its muscle every decade.

Less muscle = slower metabolism = harder fat loss.

The fix? Progressive overload.

Weeks 1: 4-5 compound lifts. 3x10. Track your weights.
Weeks 2: Same weight. Add 1-2 reps per set.
Weeks 3: Bump weight 2.5-5 lbs. Back to 10 reps.
Week 4: Deload. Drop weight 50%. Focus on form.

Repeat each month to consistently get stronger.

original_client_text.markup_text:
🚨 SMASH OR PASS? FAT LOSS FOOD EDITION 🔥

Some foods LOOK healthy but could be making it harder for you to lose those stubborn 30-50 pounds.

Here’s what I’d smash vs pass if your goal is to get leaner without starving yourself 👇

🥚 Whole Eggs: SMASH ✅
Great source of healthy fats and nutrients, but not as protein-dense as you might think.

🥜 Mixed Nuts: PASS ❌
Healthy fats, but extremely calorie-dense and way too easy to overeat.

🥣 Nonfat Greek Yogurt: SMASH ✅
High protein, low calorie, and keeps you full for hours.

🧃 Fruit Juice: PASS ❌
Easy to drink hundreds of calories without the filling fiber you’d get from whole fruit.

🥔 Boiled Potatoes: SMASH ✅
One of the most filling foods you can eat. Perfect for keeping hunger under control.

🥩 Lean Steak: SMASH ✅
Packed with protein to help preserve muscle while losing fat.

🍿 Air-Popped Popcorn: SMASH ✅
High-volume, low-calorie snack that satisfies those salty cravings.

🥣 Granola: PASS ❌
Small portions pack a TON of calories. Easy to overeat without realizing it.

💪 Whey Isolate: SMASH ✅
One of the easiest and most convenient ways to hit your daily protein goal.

🍫 Protein Bars: PASS ❌
Some are basically candy bars with a little extra protein. Check the calories before grabbing one.

You don’t need to eliminate your favorite foods to lose fat.

You just need to make smarter choices that keep you FULL while staying in a calorie deficit.

That’s how you lose 30-50 pounds without feeling like you’re constantly dieting.

🔥 Follow @cohnan for simple fat loss tips that actually fit your busy lifestyle.
